cards.note: Implement useContext providers for: AuthContext (user, permissions), CartContext (POS cart state), UIContext (theme, sidebar, toasts), SettingsContext (business config)

cards.title: Setup API Route Structure (REST + Server Actions)
cards.note: Create organized API routes: /api/auth, /api/products, /api/sales, /api/shifts, /api/inventory, /api/reports with proper validation, error handling, rate limiting

cards.title: Design System & Component Library
cards.note: Create reusable UI components: Button, Input, Select, Modal, Table, Card, Badge, Avatar, Dropdown, Tooltip, Toast, Loading states, Form components with React Hook Form + Zod
cards.label: New Feature

cards.title: Layout: Dashboard Shell (Sidebar, Header, Responsive)
cards.note: Main layout with collapsible sidebar navigation, top header with user menu/notifications, mobile-responsive drawer, breadcrumbs, page transitions
cards.label: New Feature

cards.title: Testing Setup (Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright)
cards.note: Unit tests for utilities/hooks, integration tests for API routes, E2E tests for critical flows (login, POS sale, shift close), CI/CD pipeline
cards.label: New Feature

cards.title: Hardware gateway: driver abstraction, mock + socketio, short-lived tokens
cards.note: Standalone Socket.IO gateway process (src/server/gateway.ts) with a HardwareDriver interface, MockHardwareDriver (runs the whole flow with no hardware) and SocketIoHardwareDriver (real controller). BillSession owns the accounting: denomination filtering, hold-on-overshoot since no change is given. The device credential stays server-side; browsers authenticate with a short-lived HMAC token from /api/hardware/token instead of the legacy NEXT_PUBLIC_HARDWARE_ACCESS_KEY. Verified: forged token rejected, accepted/rejected/hold events, door open ack.
cards.label: New Feature

cards.title: Offline→online sync worker with change streams
cards.note: scripts/sync-worker.ts watches the transactions collection via a change stream (requires the replica set), writes a write-ahead SyncQueue row, and forwards batches to the online cluster with upsert-by-transId, retry/backoff and status tracking. Runs as a separate process. Verified against the live replica set: insert+update queued, failure marked failed+retryCount, successful upsert marked synced, clean SIGTERM.
cards.label: New Feature

cards.title: MongoDB as the single data store (json-server removed)
cards.note: The legacy json-server LocalDatabase/LockerDetails/ForPosting/ForPatching/ForPostingPayments split is gone. Five collections replace it: doors (live state), transactions (full booking lifecycle, subsuming the LockerDetails archive), sync_queue (offline write-behind), users (operator accounts) and audit_logs (privileged actions). MPIN is select:false so it can never leak into a list response.
cards.label: New Feature

cards.title: Reports and analytics dashboard
cards.note: Not yet built. Needs: revenue by day/week/month, cash vs e-wallet split, door utilisation, promo uptake, CSV export. Data is already modelled in transactions (amount, payType, bills, bookingStatus, timeIn/timeOut) so this is a read-only reporting layer plus charts (recharts is already a dependency).
cards.label: New Feature

cards.title: Runtime settings pages (rates, promo window, kiosk copy)
cards.note: Not yet built. Door rate, promo window/rate, accepted denominations, alias length and PIN length are all env-driven today, so changing them needs a restart. A settings collection plus an admin page would make them editable at runtime; getKioskConfig() is already the single read point, so it only needs to consult the database.
cards.label: New Feature

cards.title: Product & Category Management (CRUD)
cards.note: Create/Read/Update/Delete products with categories, variants, pricing, inventory tracking, barcode support, product images
cards.label: New Feature

cards.title: Cash Register / Shift Management
cards.note: Open/close shifts, cash float management, cash counting, expected vs actual reconciliation, shift reports, multiple registers support
cards.label: New Feature

cards.title: Inventory Management
cards.note: Stock levels, low stock alerts, stock adjustments, purchase orders, supplier management, inventory valuation, stock take/audit
cards.label: New Feature
